subsystems.notes: Install/resource loading, PyKotor bridge, MCP resource tooling, and animation slot/supermodel resolution exist; shared GameResourceProvider is missing.
Reader/writer boundary and retarget animation writer exist; current working tree contains active writer fixes that should be finished separately.
Unreal to KOTOR has source import, mapping, solver, preview, and export gates. KOTOR to KOTOR and KOTOR to Unreal are explicit pending modes.
Import, guide, skeleton, and workflow services exist; native KOTOR DAG preservation and golden export/readback tests remain highest-risk gaps.
Hydration, inspection, save pipeline, reference safety, KMAP-aware UI exist. Needs unified state model and transaction save path.
KMAP/KMAX, LYT/VIS/WOK, walkmesh, export manifest and package services exist. Scenario object/cutscene authoring remains incomplete.
Qt entry points and grouped facade exist; main window is large and should keep delegating to controllers.
Many validators exist, but no shared ValidationBus or ExportJob transaction helper.

recommended_next_product_slices.module_editor: Qt edit/save/reload loop for one safe GIT object field
recommended_next_product_slices.map_builder: KMAP object placement palette backed by Module Studio template types
recommended_next_product_slices.retarget_workbench: KOTOR to KOTOR preview/export adapter using KOTOR source sampler
